description: Pre-delivery compliance check: does this file meet the platform's spec?

argv.description: raw CLI arguments (non-canonical compatibility path; when present every other key is ignored)

change_floor.description: --expect-changed: a 60x60-ish tile (the frame in 32x18) counts as changed when its largest channel difference is above N of 255 (default 24)

compare.description: also measure the picture against REFERENCE, frame by frame (SSIM and PSNR, one pass): a similarity row, WARN when the mean SSIM is under 0.98, with the worst frame's time

content.description: also check the content (one decode pass, plus an audio-only and a video-only one): black, frozen, silence, dropouts, flashes and first frame rows

dry_run.description: print the ffmpeg commands that would run, run nothing

expect_changed.description: with --compare: where the picture is allowed to differ from REFERENCE, as START-END in this file's time (repeatable), optionally only inside a rectangle of displayed pixels, or `none`. A change_scope row FAILs on a change anywhere else (with its time and place) or when the two could not be compared, and WARNs when a declared span did not change

expect_identity.description: the output_identity a writing tool reported ({size}:{mtime_ns}): an identity row FAILs when the file at INPUT is not that file (a later run replaced it, or a failed run left an older one)

fast.description: preview quality: x264 preset veryfast (overrides --preset) for quick iterations

json_brief.description: like --json but trimmed: status, output, dry_run, verified, a compact summary of the output probe, this tool's own keys, and the command count instead of the command lines (failures print the full failure document, unchanged)

levels.description: also measure the broadcast signal range (one more decode of every frame): a legal levels row with the share of luma and chroma samples outside bt709 (16-235 / 16-240) or ebu-r103 (luma -1..103 %%), and min/max Y/U/V; the JSON levels document has it per clip and per --levels-window

levels_tolerance.description: --levels: the legal levels row FAILs when one frame has more than this percentage of its luma or of its chroma samples out of range (default 1; 0 = any sample)

levels_window.description: --levels: report the shares for every window of this many seconds too (default 10; 0 = the whole clip only)

lufs.description: override loudness target, in LUFS (-14 for most platforms)

max_duration.description: the caller's own maximum length in seconds: over it FAILs when a --platform is named, WARNs with none (the platform table's limit is guidance, WARN)

max_mb.description: the caller's own maximum file size in MB: over it FAILs (the platform table's limit is guidance, WARN)

overwrite.description: no effect over MCP: this read-only tool writes no file (it governed --plan, which is refused here)

plan.description: refused over MCP (read-only tool; error.reason read_only_plan_refused): this tool writes no file here; run it from the CLI to write a plan

platform.description: delivery spec to check against (default: youtube, with judgement rows reported as WARN because no platform was named)

timeout.description: kill an ffmpeg run past this many seconds, kind=timeout (default 1800; 0 = no limit)

tp.description: override true-peak ceiling, in dBTP (-1 for most platforms)

name: check
